payload.description_html: Pareiasaurus serridens (= Nanoparia pricei), anapsid reptile from Sondagsrivierhoek, Camdeboo, Graaff-Reinet, South Africa. From the Cistecephalus Zone of the Beaufort Group in the Karoo Sequence. Cast of distorted skull of juvenile collected in February 1946 by James W. Kitching.
